{"fields":[{"OBJECTIVE":{"value":"SCOPE OF WORK
The scope of the proposal includes to
• Implementation of an end-to-end mobile banking solution with required software, middleware, and necessary web services/ APIs.
• Composite solution of mobile banking services to Bank’s customers with ability to work on all types of network/handsets and platforms.
• The proposed Mobile Banking solution should support facilities like on boarding of new and existing customers, fund transfer across Banks (within and outside <country>) as well as intra bank, Mobile recharge, Utility Bill Payments, Card/Account to Card/Account Payments, and implement necessary integration with NPCI (International UPI) and other payment aggregators for these services.
• Integration with CBS, internet banking and other third party systems to provide smooth and efficient services to the customer
• It should run on all types of handsets/Tablets/Smart phones/operating systems/browsers; existing as well as new handsets/browsers/operating systems coming in the market.
• The solution should also comply with any guidelines and mandates issued by RBI and RBNZ for Mobile Banking transactions. The bidder has to undertake to incorporate, at no cost to the Bank, suitable changes in the solution including the software, procedure and operations as required from time to time to comply with any new rules of Indian and New Zealand Law from RBI/ IBA/ MFI/ TRAI/ Govt. of India/ NPCI / RBNZ/ FMI/ Govt. of New Zealand and other Regulators for providing the Mobile Banking services during the contract period.
• The Mobile Banking solution must be capable to work on varied communication modes with or without encryption as per the requirement of the Bank.
• The mobile banking solution has to interface with Bank’s Core banking application i.e. Finacle, ATM Switch/any other middleware of the Bank/ web services/ APIs. The required customization at CBS/Switch end shall be done by the Bank.
• Bidder will be responsible for supply, installation and end to end implementation of Mobile Banking Solution, including customization, documentation, training to bank officials, etc.
• Also, there should be provision for compatibility with new OS versions and handsets coming in the market.
• The solution should be designed with redundancy in mind to ensure nil impact by failure of one or more components or software.
• Mobile Banking solution should work on multi-layered architecture (Application server, Operating System, Database).

Assumptions And Dependencies
This document is prepared as an approach paper to enable client to assess and understand the implementation methodology followed by Technology Partner. On successful acceptance of the proposed implementation methodology, an implementation agreement would be executed between Technology Partner and Client. The project schedule and estimate are prepared for the implementation of functionalities as available out of box and not based on any customizations of functionality or reports.
▪ Client will arrange for a project team with representatives from all the business areas.
▪ Client will obtain/upgrade the hardware based on the sizing.
▪ This proposal does not include any hardware device This has to be separately procured by BOI.
▪ Client shall conduct necessary Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) by a third-party vendor. For server and software related VAPT, the bank owns the full responsibility of fixing the VAPT issues before deployment.
▪ Client will pay separately for the hardware components like the Database server, Application server, Reports server and Interface server, as required based on the sizing document received.
▪ Client will pay for the licenses for all the software components required to install Database and Application, as per the specifications provided in the sizing document.
▪ Efforts for train the trainers/champions are considered for estimates. If client requires any end user training, it can be provided separately on T&M basis.
▪ Testing must be carried out by the relevant business units for User acceptance.
▪ As part of UAT preparation client must prepare the Test Cases, Test Scenarios and execution plan in line with the business requirements. Technology Partner will provide required assistance to client.
▪ Client needs to setup a dedicated team for Testing and Result validation.
▪ Client may designate a SPOC (Single Point of Contact) who will be the focal point for Technology Partner communications relative to this engagement and will have the authority to act on behalf of client in all matters regarding the engagement.
▪ Client team shall provide the answers of the questions / queries raised by Technology Partner team within two business day, to ensure that project schedule is not affected.
▪ Customization requirements would be visited and prioritized at the time of Requirement study.
▪ Customizations apart from the scope of work will be billed on T&M basis.
▪ Messages and language translation is not considered in scope at this stage.
Delivery schedule given considers only mandatory modules. After Product Walk Through (PWT), project plan & scope will be reworked in consultation with client.
▪ Technology partner assumes that all the necessary APIs (CBS and Third-party systems) will be readily available for integration with the CBS and other third-party systems.
▪ Any activity not mentioned in proposal is not covered in the scope of work, any additions that are critical for the project, must be accepted in writing by both client and Technology Partner can be taken up separately.
▪ Any activity or product feature or gap that is not discussed during the requirement gathering will follow the change management process.
▪ Customization items may need further study and analysis as the requirements mentioned in the proposal may not be sufficient for estimating the timelines.
▪ Client will organize VPN Internet facility for Technology Partner’s offshore personnel.
▪ Application, which needs to be accessed by Technology Partner Applications, shall be provided the data on daily basis by client from their respective environments.
▪ Respective data which needs to be displayed in Digital Solutions is available in Core solution and other applications.
▪ Separate Report server or Staging server is available for Digital Solution to consolidate data in environment which is separate from Core application.
▪ For configuring the application on DR site, client has to arrange a separate DR server with necessary configurations.
▪ Client shall classify the roles and provide data to link the users to roles.
▪ Report formats and field definitions will be provided by client.
▪ Payments or Value-added services Aggregator are available, and client will pay the aggregator fees, if any; and
▪ Client installs the application in separate server, in different location for DR –Disaster Recovery purpose.
▪ All implementation activities will be conducted remotely.
▪ Client will ensure reliable internet connectivity and compliance with data security regulations.
▪ Client staff will actively participate in training sessions and provide feedback during the implementation process.
▪ Setting up DR environment is responsibility of the customer.

Dependencies
The following functionalities necessitate integration with third-party systems or CBS, Techurate assumes that Bank has arranged for necessary CBS and third-party APIs for integration and making the functionality available in the application.

• APIs for Domestic or International Payment Switch
• Third Party Wallets
• Card management system
• Aggregator for Bill Payment is required to integrate with the aggregator and provide Bill payment functionality.
• KYC of customers require integration with National citizen registry.
• SIM and Device binding requires a virtual mobile number from MNO or SMS aggregator.
• For SMS and WhatsApp integration we would be requiring APIs of SMS aggregator
• SDKs to access the POS device and other necessary peripherals like printer, card reader and fingerprint scanner.","boundary":""}},{"PROPOSED":{"value":"The proposed solution is a comprehensive, end-to-end Microloan and Scoring Engine Platform designed to support the bank’s strategic objectives in delivering innovative, scalable, and efficient lending services. The platform is modular, API-driven, and cloud-ready, enabling seamless integration with internal systems such as Core Banking (CBS), Credit Reference Bureaus (CRB), payment gateways, and external data sources.
The platform empowers the bank to automate and manage the entire microloan lifecycle—from origination and scoring to disbursement, repayment, and recovery—while offering real-time insights through a robust reporting and analytics engine. With its flexible configuration capabilities, the system can support a wide range of loan products and customer segments, adapting quickly to new product introductions and regulatory requirements.
The solution incorporates a powerful scoring engine that leverages both internal transactional data and third-party inputs to provide real-time, AI-driven credit scores. This enables data-informed credit decisions, improves portfolio quality, and enhances customer onboarding efficiency.
By offering a centralized, secure, and user-friendly interface for both operational users and administrators, the platform ensures control, visibility, and operational efficiency across all stages of the lending process.

4.2 Credit Score Evaluation
Credit scoring model for instant Loan is through a diversified approach. This scoring pattern is pre-dominantly divided into two parts namely those parameters which are based on the Credit Management of the customer and another based on the non-credit related.
The following are the indicative parameters which are considered under these broad headings:
Non-Credit Parameters 
Person Age
Account Average Balance
Term Deposit for Future Maturity
Term Deposits in the Past
Employment Status
Monthly Income
Encumbrance Factor
Encumbrance Amount
Cheque Bounce History
Cheque Bounce Recent (n days)
Cheque Bounce Amount
Standing Instruction Rejections
Mandate Payments Rejections
Credit Parameters
Payment History
Amounts Owed
Length of History
Types of Credit
Debt Service Ratio

• The above parameters are further classified into various buckets and for each such sub-categories a weighted average mark is given to distinguish from each Other.
• All these parameters can be configured by the Bank depending upon the specific business requirement of the Banks and assign a weighted average score to decide the eligibility for each customer under specific customer category.
• This credit scoring engine is built to take care of even the primary eligibility criteria such as age of the customer, Un-employed customer while arriving at the scoring.
• Banks can choose to configure the minimum and maximum scoring pattern for each type of Instant Loans so that the flow can be regulated by them through this scoring mechanism.

4.3 Functionalities of Microloan and scoring engine platform

4.4 Modules of Micro Loan Management System
Loan Origination System
Loan Servicing
Aids financial organization to custom-tailor their ecosystem from amortization to delinquency tracking in one impeccable loan servicing procedure.
Collection Management
A comprehensive automated receivables system with improved decision-making system, effective collection strategies and more.

4.5 Key Features

4.6 Security Features of Proposed solution
The proposed Micro Loans and credit scoring engine solutions System is designed with a strong security framework to ensure data confidentiality, user accountability, and compliance with industry standards. Key security features include:

Data Protection
• All sensitive data is encrypted and masked at the backend.
• Encrypted folders are accessible only to authorized users.
• Passwords and database credentials are securely stored using encryption.

Secure Communication
• The system operates over SSL using the bank’s official digital certificate to protect all data transmission.

Access Control
• Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with least privilege enforcement.
• Independent user matrix for access management.
• Dual-factor authentication for enhanced login security.
• Maker-checker framework to enforce transaction validation.
• IT administrators are restricted from accessing customer transaction logs

Monitoring & Alerts
• Comprehensive audit trails and timestamped activity logs.
• Real-time alerts for unauthorized access, data tampering, brute force attempts, or host failure.

Compliance & Documentation
• Full documentation provided: architecture diagrams, process/data flows, admin and user manuals.
• Support for CMMI-level compliance and other relevant certifications.
• Transparent capacity planning (production, test, DR nodes; vCPU, RAM, storage).
• All required licenses for deployment will be clearly stated.","boundary":""}}],"fieldItems_name":"fieldItems"}
